title: Conditional liveness on lassos
contract: On a periodically repeated schedule with a continuously enabled request and at least one service action in the period, request eventually completes.
scope: Nonempty periods of length 1..3 over {0,1}; admission at least one service action; fixed repeating period.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: An enabled service action in the period is handled.
Request eventually completes on the lasso.

variants.description: Process the first service action by locating its index.
